title: Figma usage guides
description: Each library component's usage guide as the Rove Design System Figma file words it, by component. Exported from Figma by pnpm figma:export, never edited by hand; checks/figma-export.ts fails when Figma has changed since, and pnpm gen merges each guide into components.gen.json as figmaGuidance.

guides.description: Each guide by the component's export name: its own docs section's Guidance block, or for a part with no Figma component of its own, the one in its family's Parts block.
